Handbag shortbread fingers with jam.d: Butter shortbread baked pale, sandwiched with raspberry jam, dusted with sugar. Boxed for the handbag.

Diverted flight cocktail franks.d: Glazed sticky with honey, mustard, brown sugar and Worcestershire, on picks with pearl onions.

Hotel rib eye breakfast.d: Seared to order and rested, two eggs fried, hash browns and buttered toast.
Hotel rib eye breakfast.note: Breakfast in your room, 6 A.M. to noon.

Waldorf cheesecake.d: Baked slowly in a water bath on a crumb crust, chilled overnight, crowned with sliced strawberries.

Hotel bar martini.d: Gin and dry vermouth stirred ice cold, strained into a frosted glass, one green olive.
Hotel bar martini.note: From the bar. Our kitchen never runs out.
